home/evan/projects/tiny/a.txt
-- script --
option layout places
start /home/evan/projects/gloss
size 100 14
note the sidebar lists the home folders that exist, and where you have been
snapshot start
state layout places
note ctrl+g moves the cursor to it, on the first place when the folder is not one
press ctrl+g
snapshot focused
press enter
state dir /home/evan
note it settles on the place being shown; arrows pick another
press ctrl+g
press down
press enter
state dir /home/evan/Documents
snapshot documents
note typing from the sidebar goes to the filter again
press ctrl+g
type rep
state filter rep
state current report.pdf
note a click on a place goes there
click 3 6
state dir /home/evan/Pictures
snapshot clicked
